set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Add modules/spatial as a crossProject depending on linalg, image, and surface; define DomainId, MorphismId, OperatorId, SpaceRef, SamplingGeometry, Domain, DomainPart, and SpatialError. Acceptance: opaque ids with smart constructors, invalid states rejected at construction, shared code has no JVM-only dependencies, build aliases/README stay in sync, and spatialJVM/test plus spatialJS/test pass.
